description: Get a non-spoiler Socratic hint for an open journal entry.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

entry_id.description:
UUID of the caller's journal entry whose scenario the
question is about.

history.description:
Optional JSON-encoded array of prior ``{question, answer}``
turns from this clue conversation, so follow-on questions have
context. The wheel caps it hard, so oversupplying gains nothing.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

question.description:
The trainee's question, in free text. An empty or
oversized question gets a canned nudge with no LLM call.

name: optionality_ask_tip
title: Ask for a clue
